note: Shared contract between the TypeScript comparator in lib/verify.ts and a Python port of this comparator. Both test suites run every case. Adding or changing a case REQUIRES updating both copies in the same change, or one side goes red.

cases.name: no key at all is unverified
key exists but nothing extracted is a mismatch, not unverified
key exists but empty string extracted is a mismatch
identical strings match
case and surrounding whitespace are not content
collapsed inner whitespace matches
an em dash and a hyphen are the same section typed two ways
a trailing period is typography, not content
a suffix comma is typography, not content
genuinely different strings mismatch
equal numbers match
currency symbols and thousands separators are stripped
a difference inside tolerance matches
a difference outside tolerance mismatches
an ambiguous european decimal refuses to parse rather than fabricate
the unambiguous US form still parses
unparseable text against a numeric key is unverified, not a mismatch
iso date and long-form date are the same calendar day
an rfc3339 suffix is discarded, not honoured as an instant
different calendar days mismatch
a bare number is not date-shaped and falls through to text
a whole-number float against a string key is the same answer
a non-whole float against a string key keeps its decimal
booleans match
booleans mismatch
